BrochureContent.Content:
Lake View is situated just off the R362 Creggs Road in Glenamaddy and is walking distance to all amenities. Number 13 is a well-situated four bed semi-detached property, the perfect family home. A tarmac driveway leads to the front door which has a charming window beside it. The light filled hallway with laminate flooring flows into the bright and spacious sitting room with a cast iron stove fireplace with solid wood surround and laminate wood flooring. 
Double doors from the living room lead you into the kitchen / dining room at the back of the house. The kitchen is perfectly laid out and spacious and there are sliding doors from the dining space opening out onto a large back garden. A good-sized utility, a downstairs guest toilet and storage area under the stairs completes the ground floor. 
A carpeted stairs leads to the four good sized bedrooms, the master bedroom to the front is ensuite and they all have built in wardrobes. The newly reovated family bathroom is well planned a bath and a separate shower.
The secure south facing back garden is currently in grass. This ideal family home is close to all social amenities as well as excellent Primary and Secondary Schools, Supermarket & Post Office. Contact Sherry FitzGerald Todd to arrange a viewing appointment on 09326622
